findings.evidence: `ConditionallyIID/Construct.lean:87` defines `iidMixtureLaw (π : Measure T) (P : T → ProbabilityMeasure α)` generically, and `ProductKernel.lean:248` already supplies `map_prefixProj_infinitePi_const`, so the prefix calculation is not inherently restricted to `μ.map ν` or `id`.
findings.fix: First prove the natural theorem for `(iidMixtureLaw π P).map (prefixProjPair T α n) = π.bind fun t => (Measure.dirac t).prod (ProbabilityMeasure.pi fun _ : Fin n => P t).toMeasure`, then derive the current identity by specializing to `π = μ.map ν`, `P = id` and applying `bind_map`.
findings.issue: `map_prefixProjPair_iidMixtureLaw` proves only the special case `iidMixtureLaw (μ.map ν) id`, although `iidMixtureLaw` is defined for arbitrary `π : Measure T` and `P : T → ProbabilityMeasure α`.

summary: The finite-prefix law for `iidMixtureLaw` is unnecessarily restricted to a pushed-forward mixing law with the identity kernel.
